title: Combatting Gerrymandering with Ranked Choice Voting: an Experimental Analysis of Multi-member Districts in the United States
authors: Nikhil Garg; Wes Gurnee; David Rothschild; David Shmoys

human_summary_review.note: Set to human_approved only after a human has written or explicitly approved this summary; do not rewrite a human_approved summary without explicit human instruction.

human_review.source: paper-local status.json review_surface; human entries come from dashboard logs

llm_statement_review.policy: Translate each Lean statement with an LLM that has no paper context and require it to preserve every visible binder, hypothesis, domain condition, named predicate/wrapper application, equivalence direction, conclusion, and visible input. Have a third LLM compare that TeX/prose translation with the original full paper statement, not just the theorem label or phrase. A `matches` verdict requires equivalence of hypotheses, subparts, quantifiers, domains, constants, normalizations, signs, inequality directions, conclusions, and the semantics of every Lean premise. If a Lean premise is a named predicate or wrapper, the judge must inspect what that predicate means in the paper model; source-looking names are not evidence. Extra replay, certificate, process, bridge, source-row, or broad package assumptions must be judged `mismatch` or `uncertain` unless explicitly source-backed or derived from source primitives. Record the model/agent validator metadata and iterate on PaperInterface.lean until the full statement matches. If the dashboard has more than 30 rows, run a no-paper-context LLM audit that checks whether every row is paper-facing; at 120 or more rows, curate the surface before broad human review.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Maintain a paper_statement_map.json inventory of source definitions, formulas, and named statements, then use a separate LLM pass to judge whether each source item is covered by one or more dashboard rows. This paper-level accounting is required before calling a full-paper formalization closed and is separate from row-local statement matching.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Every paper-facing theorem premise not derived from prior Lean declarations must be declared in Assumptions.lean, listed in assumption_names, and judged by an independent LLM as a true paper/source model assumption rather than a proof assumption.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Every visible replay, process, bridge, source-row, or certificate-shaped input must be mapped to source primitives, a Lean-checked constructor from source primitives, or an explicit partial boundary. Source-looking Lean names are not evidence.
